authority: Reviewed T4 function admission policy; independent of submitted manifests. Adding any category/kind requires explicit policy review; observed inventory never creates a policy automatically.
verification_boundary: T4 checks metadata only. T12 verifies source/export bytes, actual nodes/transforms/clips/textures/mechanics. No model completion or geometry fidelity is asserted.
coordinate_boundary: Internal local poses are normalized XYZW quaternions. FactoryWorld root placement is position+yaw; compose its Y-axis quaternion with the full internal hierarchy for socket/normal/contact comparisons. Reject tilted root placement; never reduce internal pitch/roll to yaw.

canonical_anchors.moving_parts: For every required_functions token, moving part id and node_id must equal that token. Additional detail parts allowed but cannot replace required anchors.
canonical_anchors.fixed_parts: For every fixed_functions token, fixed part id and node_id must equal that token. state_bound_fixed_functions is a subset requiring operational_state binding; other fixed support functions may bind null.
canonical_anchors.sockets: For every required_socket_roles role, a socket with id equal to role and matching role is mandatory. Additional explicit sockets allowed.

mechanical_basis.interpretation: AOD gas delivery through tuyeres is operational without mandatory translating gas lance; optional genuine variant-specific mechanisms require separate detail references.
Gas jets wipe coating on moving strip. Fixed nozzle process state satisfies wiping; movement of the air knife itself is not mandatory.
Heating by direct firing/radiant tubes is state-dependent thermal duty. Required feed or doors describe genuine handling, never a perpetual movement substituting for heating.

placement_family_overrides.reason: The persistent ship is transport equipment within the logistics stage; this is not a mesh-reuse or caller-controlled exemption.

family_binding_policy: Existing equipment family is bound to explicit variant/placement registration below, derived from the reviewed stage-family table and named placement overrides. Broad kind eligibility is necessary but never sufficient. Mesh reuse changes geometry ownership only, never the semantic family of a placement. No cross-family shared-mesh admission exceptions are approved; any future exception requires explicit variant/placement/family/policy and QA review.
